verdict.rationale: Live-call monitoring and alerting is a fair axis for a voice agent platform, but the evidence pack documents no production call monitoring, dashboards, error-rate metrics, or alerting. The A/B testing mention covers comparing configurations by business outcomes, not alerting on agent misbehavior or error spikes.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
